\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 244-247 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R252-first-pass-words-from-chapters-244-247}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a guard and a street sweeper.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item an earthquake, a flood, a bush, a branch, a pine tree
  \item a swan, a nest, a wing, a horn, football
  \item a page, a message, a drawer, an electric fan, electricity
  \item a tin, spices, scales, a samovar, a wire
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
An earthquake? (\textbf{\fa{زلزله}}, \emph{zelzele}.) A flood? (\textbf{\fa{سیل}}, \emph{sel}.) A bush? (\textbf{\fa{بوته}}, \emph{bute}.) A branch? (\textbf{\fa{شاخه}}, \emph{shâkhe}.) A pine tree? (\textbf{\fa{کاج}}, \emph{kâj}.) A swan? (\textbf{\fa{قو}}, \emph{qu}.) A nest? (\textbf{\fa{لانه}}, \emph{lâne}.) A wing? (\textbf{\fa{بال}}, \emph{bâl}.) A horn? (\textbf{\fa{شاخ}}, \emph{shâkh}.) Football? (\textbf{\fa{فوتبال}}, \emph{futbâl}.) A page? (\textbf{\fa{صفحه}}, \emph{safhe}.) A message? (\textbf{\fa{پیام}}, \emph{payâm}.) A drawer? (\textbf{\fa{کشو}}, \emph{keshow}.) An electric fan? (\textbf{\fa{پنکه}}, \emph{panke}.) Electricity? (\textbf{\fa{برق}}, \emph{barq}.) A tin? (\textbf{\fa{قوطی}}, \emph{quti}.) Spices? (\textbf{\fa{ادویه}}, \emph{adviye}.) Scales? (\textbf{\fa{ترازو}}, \emph{tarâzu}.) A samovar? (\textbf{\fa{سماور}}, \emph{samâvar}.) A wire? (\textbf{\fa{سیم}}, \emph{sim}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 248-252 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R252-second-pass-words-from-chapters-248-252}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a coat hanger and a clip.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a coat hanger, a clip, a shoelace, cement, plaster
  \item a piece, turmeric, crispy rice from the bottom of the pot, celery, a sour cherry
  \item a secretary, an engineer, a lawyer, a university lecturer, a pilot
  \item an artist, a referee, a coach, a player, history
  \item a grocer, a pastry shop, a firefighter, a guard, a street sweeper
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A coat hanger? (\textbf{\fa{چوب} \fa{لباسی}}, \emph{chub-lebâsi}.) A clip? (\textbf{\fa{گیره}}, \emph{gire}.) A shoelace? (\textbf{\fa{بند} \fa{کفش}}, \emph{band-e kafsh}.) Cement? (\textbf{\fa{سیمان}}, \emph{simân}.) Plaster? (\textbf{\fa{گچ}}, \emph{gach}.) A piece? (\textbf{\fa{تکه}}, \emph{tekke}.) Turmeric? (\textbf{\fa{زردچوبه}}, \emph{zardchube}.) Crispy rice from the bottom of the pot? (\textbf{\fa{ته} \fa{دیگ}}, \emph{tahdig}.) Celery? (\textbf{\fa{کرفس}}, \emph{karafs}.) A sour cherry? (\textbf{\fa{آلبالو}}, \emph{âlbâlu}.) A secretary? (\textbf{\fa{منشی}}, \emph{monshi}.) An engineer? (\textbf{\fa{مهندس}}, \emph{mohandes}.) A lawyer? (\textbf{\fa{وکیل}}, \emph{vakil}.) A university lecturer? (\textbf{\fa{استاد}}, \emph{ostâd}.) A pilot? (\textbf{\fa{خلبان}}, \emph{khalabân}.) An artist? (\textbf{\fa{هنرمند}}, \emph{honarmand}.) A referee? (\textbf{\fa{داور}}, \emph{dâvar}.) A coach? (\textbf{\fa{مربی}}, \emph{morabbi}.) A player? (\textbf{\fa{بازیکن}}, \emph{bâzikon}.) History? (\textbf{\fa{تاریخ}}, \emph{târikh}.) A grocer? (\textbf{\fa{بقال}}, \emph{baqqâl}.) A pastry shop? (\textbf{\fa{قنادی}}, \emph{qannâdi}.) A firefighter? (\textbf{\fa{آتش} \fa{نشان}}, \emph{âtashneshân}.) A guard? (\textbf{\fa{نگهبان}}, \emph{negahbân}.) A street sweeper? (\textbf{\fa{رفتگر}}, \emph{roftegar}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
